ad_library.summary: PNR Sunrise Energies has one active Meta ad - opened 12 November 2026 - and it is a channel-partner recruitment ad, not a homeowner offer: the copy invites solar installers to 'partner with us' and the button opens a WhatsApp chat, while the website is only mentioned in the body text. scope_note: The single-page site was read in full through the W3C checker's source view (lines 1-683) and the closing inline script block. There is no script from Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Clarity, Hotjar or any tag manager in the served HTML - the only JavaScript is the site's own. That is a source-code finding: nothing on this page is measured today, but a tag could still be added server-side, which a page read cannot see. The homepage counters render as '0+', '0 MW' and '0%', and the canonical link points at https://www.sunriseenergies.example/ - a placeholder domain - so the page tells Google the authoritative copy lives somewhere that does not exist.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
